last_summary: Replication Watch run 11 (gear 1, free deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash; no quota error, no gear-2). +3 validations; domains rotated to LENR + phytoacoustics + colour therapy (plant acoustics had no prior record; colour therapy had one, uncontrolled). (1) LENR sub-keV fusion plateau — Karahadian, Colborne, Persaud, Schenkel & Munday (UC Davis + Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory), Nature Communications 2026-07-18, doi 10.1038/s41467-026-74421-1 (arXiv:2512.06212): D–D fusion yield in palladium and titanium hydrides sits on a finite yield floor below ~2 keV instead of falling exponentially, >10^18 above bare-nucleus expectation; effective screening potential Ue rises with electrochemical loading (Pd 0.8→1.7 keV, Ti 0.3→0.9 keV); >350 h background, proton AND neutron channels, and the load-bearing control that electrochemical loading ALONE produces no detectable fusion products. INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION — Czerski group (Szczecin / EU CleanHME), arXiv:2605.27438, plateau reproduced in Ti and Pd extending their own Zr result, but explained by a thermal-spike/ion-track mechanism, NOT the heterogeneous-screening renormalisation the Davis group proposes: the labs agree on the SHAPE and disagree on the CAUSE. Filed HIGH that the measurement is real and mainstream-vetted / LOW that it settles mechanism or has any energy relevance. (2) Phytoacoustics — Place, Kunz, Sager, Hentgen & Wigger, J. Microbiological Methods 241:107393 (2026), doi 10.1016/j.mimet.2026.107393: 3 Pleurotus species × 4 frequencies at 80 dB with untreated controls — the sign flips by species AND frequency, and P. ostreatus is negative at all four. Paired with Pagano et al. (CNR-IRET Florence, 2026): Vicia faba at 98 Hz / 74 dB is significantly HARMFUL (chlorophyll −14.2%, stomatal conductance −26.7%, leaf fresh mass −36.9%, dry −40.8%); and Minh & Bui (Russ. J. Plant Physiol. 2026): a mid-band optimum with 8 kHz worse than silence. Filed MEDIUM that the effect class is real / LOW that any dose generalises. (3) Colour therapy — Safari Nezhad, Salari, Jalali & Panahi (Kermanshah University of Medical Sciences, Iran), SAGE Open Nursing 2025;11:23779608251396225, doi 10.1177/23779608251396225: 190 chemotherapy patients randomised to a blue-themed room vs a standard room for 20 min, Beck Anxiety 57.70→50.03 (p=.001) vs 56.48→55.83 (p=.406), ANCOVA η²=0.131 — read against the dismantling control Jonauskaite et al. 2020 (Color Research & Application 45(3):450–464, doi 10.1002/col.22490), which found the same before-after improvement whether or not participants actually saw colours. Filed MEDIUM on execution (genuine randomisation + allocation concealment) / LOW that colour is the active ingredient (unblindable; control is a whole room, not a sham colour). STANDING, NOT ESCALATED: translator bulk-lane R159 still stands in Forge's files; publish boundary holds (Tier 2 pending Sandra) = a DECISION, not an alarm. Feed NOT rebuilt from the sandbox (11th confirmation of the rule — the narrow cone is missing translations/sources/books/database, so the builder would silently zero it); the hourly aflinks-cron bake folds synthesis/validations/*.md in with no gate, and a post-bake verification wake is armed for 2026-10-12T09:35Z. No file mutated outside navigator/ and synthesis/validations/.
